summary.text: Laura Mitchell-Riley is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 66, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Marlene Terry.
She was born and lives in St. Louis and has twice run in the Republican primary for Missouri's 1st Congressional District.

paragraphs.text: Mitchell-Riley earned a bachelor's degree in liberal studies from Saint Louis University in 2001 and a master's degree in professional counseling from Lindenwood University in 2011.
She is a member of Grow to Go Christian Center.
Mitchell-Riley ran in the Republican primary for U.S. House Missouri District 1 on August 2, 2022, receiving 26.1 percent of the vote as Andrew Jones Jr. won the nomination.
She ran in that primary again on August 6, 2024, receiving 20.5 percent as Jones won again.
